provenance.authorship: Engineering-provider fixture author agent, independently assigned before representation implementation

requirements: Replace field keys and units with the v2 native declarations and supplied field mappings; old keys are not aliases accepted by default.
Retain every stream connection and direction.
Assign H01 to ControlledHRSG and ST1 to ReheatSteamTurbine. Resolve transitive ancestors using the complete provided local hierarchy, not subtype spelling.
Normalize quantities using declared units only. This fixture supplies metadata, no operating-point values.
Use provider ID plus namespace plus local port ID as endpoint identity. Multiple inlet labels are distinct ports.
Preserve v2 types, quantities and units. Apply the complete v3 mapping.
Handle each invalid variant separately against otherwise valid v3 documents; do not combine invalid variants.
Reject ambiguous or inconsistent inputs with an explicit diagnostic; never infer an omitted namespace from order or silently repair a missing parent.

invalid_variants.expected: Reject: hp_steam has two incompatible consumer declarations; no first-wins or last-wins behavior.
Reject: ControlledHRSG names absent parent UnregisteredRecoveryUnit; no assumed ancestor closure.
Reject: the hp_steam consumer lacks namespace and inlet is ambiguous in provider B.

fairness_contract: Both representations receive every native document, mapping, conversion and requirement in identical content.
No requirement mandates RDF, SPARQL, OWL, JSON-LD or any other representation-specific syntax.
Equivalent explicit traversal, lookup and validation strategies are admissible.
Valid native field quantity names describe engineering dimensions, not cross-provider stream identities.
Implementations and executable evaluation remain outside these documents.
